scope: Test harness only; tests/ui-audit.e2e.js. App/runtime unchanged.

findings.originalFailure: Retained parent immutable-image/ui/... toggle restore timed out after 8 seconds on expressions_reroll_if_same; original handle identity was not captured.
findings.observed: Focused strict original actions with failure-only diagnostics passed all provider/options states. No failure diagnostic triggered.
findings.inference: Long-lived ElementHandles can outlive native redraws, so identified controls and prior radio controls now resolve by stable keyed Locator for each native action/restoration.
findings.limitation: This does not establish stale handles as the cause of the original reroll timeout. No app defect was established and no app patch was made.

findings.observed: The scroll callback received connected:false,currentNode:false and a 0x0 element. The replacement was found by later locator assertions but remained offscreen because the prior scroll targeted a detached node.
findings.correction: Bounded fresh connected-node scroll and unchanged strict viewport assertion retried together; same contrast and toggle outcomes remain.

retainedHarnessCorrection.cause: Fresh locator selector used generic#id while native memory HTML gives the same id to a label and its input. That broadened the original inputs-only helper domain.
retainedHarnessCorrection.correction: Use input#id for both active controls and prior radio controls, retaining strict unique control lookup.
